issue.title: Private event notes for Google Calendar events
issue.description: Bryan can give any Google Calendar event (including events other people own and invitations he has not answered yet) Bob-only metadata at RSVP time: `@route`, `#off`/`#on`, `-30 reason`, `+15 reason`, and prose. He can write it from the CLI, over SSH, or from Bob Mac Capture. The metadata lands on the event's Event Task exactly as if those lines were in the Google description, and it beats that description field by field. Bob never writes to Google: it validates notes at write time, previews them faithfully, and never drops one silently.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/private_gcal_event_notes.md requests this work

issue.title: Note store and per-field layering engine
issue.description: engine: add the `gcal.note` journal record and its last-writer-wins fold, parse notes on the plain-text description path, and layer occurrence and series notes over Google's description in `snapshot::fetch_day`. Give the root a note-first source, keep note bullets outside the cap, mark notes in `list` and `sync`, add list JSON identity fields, and test it all with hand-written journal records.

Add the preview and save JSON with highlight spans, golden JSON fixtures for the Mac, and the `docs/gcal-notes.md` contract.
